user_evidence: PiP video spins while audio continues; user then reports app restart resolved it and asks whether cache accumulation caused it.
diagnosis_boundary: Restart rebuilds transient player/presentation state but generally retains disk cache. No evidence establishes disk-cache exhaustion or a reproduced hardware root cause. App-controlled presentation mutations during PiP handoff are concrete competing paths, addressed preventively.

implementation.fullscreen: Retain original DOM/style/popover/fullscreen-event state throughout PiP instead of finishing at entry. Relay hold through cross-origin ancestor iframe chain. Restore after actual inline return on next display frame; reconcile missing exit event on visibility return; preserve native-fullscreen return and reject outdated cleanup generations.
implementation.viewport: Freeze WKWebView content bounds through PiP/inactive handoff and release only after foreground inline return on next main turn. Parent overview transforms/stroke remain unchanged.
implementation.audio_orientation: Retain0.16.4 Web playback/lock lease. Avoid additional native audio-category writes during OS-owned PiP; automatic fullscreen-to-PiP orientation cleanup relaxes the mask without forcing immediate scene geometry back.
implementation.data: No cache/user-data clearing, reload, forced media play/pause/PiP exit or player/source replacement. No legacy media observer flag overwrite or synthetic media-event resync.

verification_policy.release_workflow: One-time Release device build/inspection/publish/anonymous delivery only; removed after completion; normal ios.yml unchanged.

checks.audio_policy: passed; saved mixing preference, PiP/lock ownership and restoration/capture/pause/mute; AudioSession and PiP are mocked, no forced play or exit
checks.video_policy: passed in Chromium with actual H264/AAC decoded-frame callbacks: PiP handoff preserves original DOM/style/popover and fullscreenchange count, parent iframe viewport stays expanded, frames and time advance, cleanup follows actual exit, visible inline return reconciles a missing exit event, native-fullscreen return and end-before-mode event ordering remain stable. Native/PiP APIs mocked.

limits: The reported iPhone spinner was not reproduced here; actual native PiP video, lock/unlock, specific-site acceptance and hardware decoder/resource behavior remain unverified.
Restart recovery alone does not establish either cache accumulation or the exact cause. Local decoded-frame checks cover app DOM policy, not iOS remote presentation layers.
No universal PiP/background other-app mixing guarantee;0.16.4 continuity priority remains.
